proof:

have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := hf.differentiableAt (by simp)
have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y v) z :=
  ((hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).clm_apply (contDiffAt_const : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun _ : E => v) z)).differentiableAt_one
have hh := hd.hasFDerivAt.inner ℝ hg.hasFDerivAt
have hz : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E => (0 : ℝ)) _ z := hh.congr_of_eventuallyEq ht
have he := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) (hz.unique (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) z))
simp [fderivInnerCLM_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at he
linarith
